text: Provides Python, TypeScript, and REST SDKs to integrate browser automation into your own product
quote: Integrate browser automation into your product with Python, TypeScript, or REST.

text: Can be self-hosted entirely on your own servers and browsers using your own LLM API keys
quote: Run Skyvern on your own infrastructure with your own LLM keys.

text: Cloud UI dashboard lets you build and run automations visually with drag-and-drop blocks, no code required
quote: Build multi-step automations visually in the Cloud UI with drag-and-drop blocks. No code required. Share templates across your team.

text: Can extract structured, schema-validated data from any page via a JSON schema
quote: you can extract structured data from any page using `page.extract` with a JSON schema, or by passing a `data_extraction_schema` to `page.agent.run_task`

text: SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP and layers Playwright on top for code-first automation
quote: Browser Automation is the code-first way to build multi-step automations. The Skyvern SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP, layers Playwright on top, and injects AI into every page interaction.

text: Ships an MCP server so AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf can control a browser
quote: The Skyvern MCP server lets AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Windsurf control a browser.

text: Handles logins including stored credentials, TOTP/2FA, email/SMS verification, magic links, and password manager integrations
quote: Skyvern handles logins with stored credentials, TOTP/authenticator codes, email and SMS verification, magic links, and password manager integrations with Bitwarden, 1Password, and Azure Key Vault.

text: Detects and automatically solves CAPTCHAs (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile, FunCaptcha, MTCaptcha, text CAPTCHAs) via a vision model
quote: Skyvern detects CAPTCHAs using its vision model and solves them automatically. This works for reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, FunCaptcha/ArkoseLabs, MTCaptcha, and standard text/number image CAPTCHAs.

text: Supports human-in-the-loop pauses for approval and a live VNC stream to watch or take over a running session
quote: Human-in-the-loop flows: pause for approval between steps without losing browser state. The VNC stream lets you watch or take control at any point.

text: Every run automatically captures session recordings, screenshots, AI reasoning, and network traffic for later review
quote: Every run automatically captures what happened: recordings of the browser session, screenshots at each step, the AI's reasoning, and network traffic.

text: Can automate job application forms (auto-fill and submit) on ATS platforms like Lever and Greenhouse
quote: Auto-fill and submit applications on Lever, Greenhouse, and more.

text: Can log into vendor portals, locate invoices, and download PDF files, with artifacts retrievable afterward
quote: Log into vendor portals, find invoices, download PDFs.

text: Operates on previously unseen websites by mapping visual page elements to actions without site-specific custom code
quote: Skyvern can operate on websites it's never seen before, as it's able to map visual elements to actions necessary to complete a workflow, without any customized code

text: Offers a Zapier integration to connect automations with other apps
